create_seq_from_text: create a Seq object from a list of text strings using a tokenizer and device
create_seq_from_logits: create a Seq object from raw logits tensors with an optional attention mask
stack_seqs_batch: stack a list of Seq objects into a single batched Seq along the batch dimension
merge_seqs_with_mergedseq: merge multiple Seq objects into a MergedSeq that concatenates them along the sequence dimension
convert_msg_to_seq: convert a string message or existing Seq into a device-ready Seq using msg_to_seq
